_test_case_note: TC-DAG-001 (positive): one physical external table -- {{catalog}}.dag_001_usecase.shared_source_bus -- is read by THREE different flow kinds inside this ONE dataflow group's unified Lakeflow pipeline: (1) ingestion_flows[0]'s own zerobus source_config, (2) transformation_flows[0]'s source_inputs[0] ('shared_source_direct', reading the same locator directly rather than through the ingestion flow's Bronze output), and (3) reconciliation_flows[0]'s target_configs[0] (the raw bus compared, target_to_source, against the freshly-ingested Bronze copy). The ingestion consumer streams (zerobus into a streaming_table); the transformation and reconciliation consumers are batch (is_streaming/read_mode both false/'batch'). Because fanout on this one locator is 3 (>= the source_plane 'auto' threshold of 2) and at least one consumer streams, engine/source_plane.py must register exactly ONE materialized L0 node -- a streaming table (`_src__shared_source_bus__<8hex>__stream`), never a view -- and reuse it for all three, so the pipeline's own event log shows exactly one physical read of this locator per update (tests/integration/test_flowx_dag_001_unified_three_flow.py asserts this). Reconciliation's source_config.table is deliberately the in-spec Bronze target (not the raw bus) rather than the raw bus itself: V-CYC-1 requires a pipeline-mode reconciliation source to resolve to a dataset THIS group's own graph produces, so the raw external bus can only appear on reconciliation's target side (comparison_direction 'target_to_source' -- no append_target_table needed) -- still the same source-plane dedup mechanism, just addressed via a different bind() consumer id (`<reconciliation_id>:target:<target_id>` instead of `<reconciliation_id>:source`). See flowx_testing/TESTING_PLAN.md TC-DAG-001 and docs/13's CANONICAL IDENTITY / SHARING RULES sections.

ingestion_flows.source_description: TC-DAG-001: zerobus ingestion of {{catalog}}.dag_001_usecase.shared_source_bus -- the SAME physical locator that transformation_flows[0]'s source_inputs[0] and reconciliation_flows[0]'s target_configs[0] ALSO read directly. Exactly one physical scan of this table per pipeline update, shared via the read-once source plane.

transformation_flows.source_description: TC-DAG-001: reads {{catalog}}.dag_001_usecase.shared_source_bus directly as a batch transformation input -- the SAME external locator ingestion_flows[0] streams via zerobus -- rather than reading ingestion's own Bronze output, to prove the source plane dedups a cross-flow-kind read of one physical table, not merely a cross-consumer-within-one-flow read.
